tools.name: list_analysis_portfolios
tools.description: List owner-scoped portfolios, analytics datasets, and profile readiness.

tools.name: list_portfolio_series
tools.description: Discover owner-scoped immutable series profiles and their exact dataset versions. This returns metadata and coverage only, never dataset rows.

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description: Read private calculation groups and independent operations. Filter by kind, portfolio, dates, ready/running/attention status or legacy open/finished status.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Read retained normalized inputs, operations, results and owner-scoped dataset references. This is not an external agent transcript.

tools.name: evaluate_portfolio_alignment
tools.description: Compare a clean mandate with normalized holdings. Do not send PDF, CSV, spreadsheet, or factsheet files; extract them before calling.

tools.name: calculate_portfolio_constraints
tools.description: Calculate explicit portfolio constraints deterministically from normalized holdings. Use this for arithmetic checks, not for interpreting natural-language mandates.

tools.name: upload_portfolio_series_rows
tools.description: Upload normalized series_key/date/value/distribution rows and commit a dataset version. For up to 5,000 rows, omit chunk_index and total_chunks to complete in one call. tools.description: Cancel a pending upload and permanently remove its staging chunks.

tools.name: review_portfolio_series_profile
tools.description: Create an immutable profile revision using revise, or explicitly confirm a warning-free proposal with confirmation=true.

tools.name: calculate_portfolio_statistics
tools.description: Calculate historical return, volatility, drawdown, risk-adjusted and benchmark-relative statistics from a confirmed portfolio series profile. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "evaluate_portfolio_alignment" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Compare a clean mandate with normalized holdings. Do not send PDF, CSV, spreadsheet, or factsheet files; extract them before calling.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_analysis · Private data: list_analyses, evaluate_portfolio_alignment, upload_portfolio_series_rows · Public sink: evaluate_portfolio_alignment, upload_portfolio_series_rows, cancel_portfolio_series_upload · Destructive: cancel_portfolio_series_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_analysis · Private data: list_analyses, evaluate_portfolio_alignment, upload_portfolio_series_rows · Public sink: evaluate_portfolio_alignment, upload_portfolio_series_rows, cancel_portfolio_series_upload · Destructive: cancel_portfolio_series_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
